summary: No Stopping kerb at a busy junction beside the rail line.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign here

drivers.seclusion: Apartment building 16 m away and a busy junction with turning lanes and painted islands.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along a kerb island between lanes and a turn slip; there is no space to pull out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Heavy through traffic on a main road, with rail beside it.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign; cars park only further down a side road, not here.

sun_shade: Open, no cover; the apartment block shades the west side in the morning.
